overclaims: The agent benchmark uses simulated services and users, a small task set and fallible automated judgments.
checks.note: Excerpt, proposition, conditions, axis, open horizon, unresolved outcome and citations all match. One limitation goes beyond e3. The quoted e3 context shows only a simulated user, plus 34 tasks, which supports 'small'. It never says the services were simulated or that grading was automated, so 'fallible automated judgments' is unsupported. Minor: the e1 locator gives April 7–17, 2025 collection, but the quoted text says searches were from March 2025. The methodology isn't quoted, so I didn't fail on that.
